# `get_batch_stack_thumbnail`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Fetch a thumbnail for a batch-stack frame type as a binary transfer.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | method (client sends) |
| Grade | MUTATOR / established (64-bit build; 32-bit build matches (READ)) |
| Side-effect tier | D |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, imager handler @0x1f05a0 (64-bit build), GetFilesThbnl @0x3a8390 |

Registered in the imager file table of both builds. Optional params select the frame type: `frame_type` `light`, `dark`, `bias` or `flat`; absent or null params mean light (READ). Behaviour for other names is unresolved. The response is a binary thumbnail or a textual no-image error, not ordinary command JSON. An empty cached list and an invalid frame type each log a diagnostic.

Side effects: Builds or reads file thumbnails; conditional diagnostic logging. Metadata, image, cache and database effects are not bounded.

## Request params

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | any | yes | - | Client-chosen request identifier, echoed in the reply as parsed (same JSON type). Required; a request without one is rejected with code 200. The device accepts any JSON value: zero, negative, string, null, boolean and composite ids are all treated as real requests, not notifications. Clients SHOULD use an integer or a string and SHOULD keep ids unique among outstanding requests. On early dispatcher errors (100, 200) the reply carries id null. [READ] |
| `method` | string | yes | - | Fixed value `"get_batch_stack_thumbnail"`. [READ] |
| `params` | object\|null | no | - | Optional. Absent or null params select light frames. Present params must be an object (107 otherwise) with a string frame_type (105 otherwise). Names other than the four listed: behaviour unresolved. [READ] |
| `params.frame_type` | string | yes | - | Frame type of the batch stack. Clients SHOULD send only these four names. One of: `light`, `dark`, `bias`, `flat`. [READ] |

## Reply

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|

## Errors

| Code | Trigger | Label |
|---|---|---|
| 107 | params present and not an object (and not null) | `expected object param` |
| 105 | params object without a string frame_type | `expected string param` |

Other failures are text replies (for example, no image available).

## Example

Request, request:

```json
{"id":1,"method":"get_batch_stack_thumbnail"}
```
